Phonetic Datasets Bundled with MVBeliefUpdatr

Source: R/data.R
datasets.Rd

Bundled phonetic corpora and experimental datasets for modeling speech perception, category representation, and incremental belief updating.

See also

h95, pb52, swehvd, mixer6

Examples

# Inspect bundled datasets
data(h95)
data(pb52)
head(h95)
